messages:
tariq: quick follow-up from the PM: we saw a recurring pattern of tight headroom + autoscaler thrash. want to lock owners for: quota petitions, conservative scheduler heuristics, and a small capacity-buffer policy. short timelines pls.

maya: i'll own scheduler heuristics. immediate plan: apply conservative emergency knobs (reduce max batch, raise preemption priority for system jobs) then iterate with telemetry. aim: emergency knobs in 4d, refined tuning in 12d.

anita: i'll own quota petitions and vendor uplift. opening cloud/vendor cases today; will surface any minimum-commit asks. ETA for initial replies: 48-72h. tagging finance if spend approvals needed.

sam: i'll draft the capacity-buffer policy (small reserved pool + burst lifecycle). propose burst = 6% of fleet or 8 GPUs min per region. draft by +5d and include automation hooks to pre-warm.

leo: i can run the perf harness and synthetic surge tests. need 6 ephemeral GPUs for 48h next week. will post a schedule.

metrics-bot: incident snapshot saved: peak util 99.2%, headroom fell below 5% for 3h, repeated autoscale churn detected. storing traces at s3://incidents/gpu/2105551234/traces.json

```
Action items (confirm):
- QUOTA PETITIONS: owner=anita, due=+3d, steps=[open tickets, vendor follow-up, cost approval]
- SCHEDULER HEURISTICS: owner=maya, due=+4d (emergency), full tuning due=+12d
- CAPACITY-BUFFER POLICY: owner=sam, due=+5d, steps=[policy draft, automation pre-warm, smoke test]
- PERF HARNESSES: owner=leo, due=+7d, steps=[allocate ephems, run surge sims, post results]
- DASHBOARDS & DETECTION: owner=tariq, due=+2d, steps=[add headroom meter, autoscale-thrash alert]
```

tariq: i'll create a lightweight tracker and a 25-min sync (Weds 09:30 PT). tracker link: https://docs.internal/redwood/incidents/2105551234 (placeholder). please update tracker rows with blockers.

maya: quick config snippet i'll test for emergency mode:

```yaml
scheduler:
  max_batch_tokens: 1024  # was 2048
  prefer_small_batches: true
  preemption:
    system_priority_boost: 0.3
    threshold: 0.3
```

anita: opening tickets now. if vendor requires commit we'll evaluate short-term burst reservations vs reserving GPU credits.

sam: runbook will include an ops checklist: pre-warm burst, enable emergency knobs, route-shed low-priority traffic, rollback plan. tabletop at next sync.

opsbot: created REM-7234, calendar event "GPU Capacity Buffer Sync" (Weds 09:30 PT), reminders 24h and 1h before. subtasks assigned.

leo: ack, will post the perf schedule in tracker. requesting ephemeral GPUs approved by tariq.

metrics-bot: 72h headroom projection: 4-7% depending on region and weekday traffic. recommend pre-warm before major launches.

tariq: thanks. if anyone hits blockers on approvals or perms ping me. first sync next Weds to review baselines and ticket updates.
